verdict.rationale: A documented public API is a fair question for an authenticator app, since comparable credential and 2FA products expose APIs or CLIs, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes manual in-app actions: swipe to edit or delete, drag to reorder, and QR transfer. The GitHub repo offers open-source HOTP/TOTP implementations and a PAM module, which are standalone components, not a documented API for programmatically driving the app.
